meshy_task.text_style_prompt: Bramblebun, a stylised meadow rabbit creature. Warm mid-brown fur with darker brown flecks, cream-white chest, chin and inner legs, cream fluffy tail; inner ears soft tan-beige; dark brown eyes with a white catchlight, dark brown nose. A soft olive-moss green mantle of small leaves and a few tiny lavender flowers along the upper back only. Paws brown with cream toes. Matte hand-painted stylised look, clean colour blocks, no noise, no speckle. No red, no pink, no rust, no maroon, no oxblood anywhere.

generation_verdict: PRIMARY: Warm brown fur, cream chest/chin/tail, tan inner ears, olive-moss leaf mantle with lavender blooms on the back; red/pink 0.01% (noise), no rust. Red/lime noise of the candidate is gone.

palette.red_metric: texels with HSV hue <24 or >320 deg, saturation >0.25, value >0.12 (the retex worker clamp rule), over the whole 2048 atlas

transfer.atlas_identity: candidate Image_0 is byte-identical to the recovered model texture (sha256 7295b98f210ff87f9b31d0e2f588b610c5b911658b4dda772251365d49035d1a)

uv_check.method: candidate triangle centroids (decimated mesh) projected to the nearest retexture triangle after bbox normalisation and best of 8 yaw/mirror alignments; interpolated UV compared to centroid UV

transfer.uv_check_summary: Decimated candidate UVs sample the retexture atlas consistently: median 0.35 texel error at triangle centroids, 85.3% within 1 texel, 96.3% within 4 texels. The retex worker found retexture (position, UV) pairs match the recovered model 99.99-100% (welds only), and the candidate atlas is byte-identical to the recovered texture, so the maps occupy the exact atlas space the candidate already samples. The remaining centroids are ordinary-sized triangles (median longest UV edge 11.32 texels vs 15.66 for inliers, so not seam-straddling) whose nearest retexture surface after bbox normalisation lies on another UV island (thin or near-coincident sheets); they still sample the same atlas texels the candidate samples with its original Image_0, because the UVs themselves are unchanged.
transfer.maps: base colour, metallic-roughness (packed; metallicFactor/roughnessFactor 1.0 from the Meshy material) and normal from the retexture GLB embedded images

scale_note: Same mesh, skin and runtime fit as the multiview candidate; only material images differ.
